## Summary

What changed, and which sanitized issue/reproduction does it address?

## Evidence

- [ ] Minimal neutral regression fixture added
- [ ] Root build, typecheck, lint and unit tests
- [ ] Stdio, synthetic protocol, runtime, launcher, daemon and controller checks
- [ ] Vendored build and unit tests
- [ ] Publication manifest/privacy check
- [ ] Dependency/license changes reviewed, or none

List exact passed/failed/skipped checks and reasons. Do not claim a real-server test unless it was explicitly authorized and actually completed. Never attach raw private state, tokens, real endpoints, chat or account identifiers.

## Compatibility and safety

Tool/IPC/schema changes, interruption/timeout/replay behavior, known limits, and upgrade/rollback effect:

## Review

- [ ] Changelog and relevant documentation updated
- [ ] Maintainer review requested; no automatic merge or deployment
- [ ] No collaborator or security-setting changes included without owner approval
